status: proposed-after-baseline; approval required before ranking changes
appliesTo: this frozen synthetic corpus and comparable local isolated runner only
rules: Proposed thresholds follow two baseline builds; not statistically calibrated production SLAs.
Baseline fails the future uncertainty/freshness requirements and has no citation capability; never mark those gates passing.
File-level section coverage is an optimistic upper bound, not section localisation or citation correctness.
Cold means fresh process/SQLite connection; the OS cache is not flushed.
Performance budgets are reported, not machine-independent CI timing assertions.
A new ranking release must evaluate both fixed splits; do not tune held-out labels or silently relax thresholds.
